responses: Welcome to the Training and Placement Department of City Engineering College. It is the interface between the industry and the institute, providing a platform for industries to recruit the right talent and kickstart a dream career for students. The department provides job opportunities to graduating students through the campus recruitment process, which typically begins in the pre-final year and continues until the end of the course and beyond. The department handles all aspects of placements, including contacting companies, managing logistics for pre-placement talks, assessments (both online and offline), selections, and finally collecting employer feedback. It organizes career guidance and industry-specific training programs. The Department of Training and Placement has well-furnished and air-conditioned interview cabins, group discussion spaces, the Director's room, the Assistant Placement Officer's room, LCD displays for notifications, restrooms, and drinking water facilities.
